page.overview:
Who is Bowser Jr.?

Bowser Jr. is the secondary antagonist of The Super Mario Bros. Movie film series produced by Illumination, serving as the main antagonist of The Super Mario Galaxy Movie.

He is the son of Bowser and also heir of the Koopa Army who plans to exact his vengeance on the Mario Bros. for his father's defeat by seeking to restore him to his normal size and destroy the universe with Rosalina's cosmic powers.

Bowser Jr. is relatively similar in appearance to his video game counterpart, except with some differences, such as having proper eyes with red irises rather than beady eyes, and the mouth on his bandana seemingly being more neatly coloured.

When using the power of his magic brush, he turns into a form similar to that of his video game counterpart’s Wonder and his new Fury transformations, only in his wonder form his body is darker and his bandana’s mouth is yellow instead of green. Unlike in Wonder where the bandana fully opens and closes like a mouth, here it appears to be animated in 2D, though it seemingly becomes fully modelled when roaring.

Also known as: Bowser Junior, Junior.
